rationale: The prior model deposited the full 0.75 A main-rail allocation at U201. The release source now enforces 160 MHz CPU and +3 dBm BLE with no Wi-Fi initialization. 0.45 A retains large margin over Espressif's published BLE active-TX peaks bracketing this setting (176 mA at 0 dBm and 193 mA at 9 dBm), while allowing CPU/PSRAM/peripheral overhead. This is an engineering release allocation and must be checked during bring-up; it is not a hardware current limiter.
invalidators: materially increased radio duty or removal of the 120/s notification budget
measured sustained U201/main-profile current above 0.45 A under the release workload
hardware_capacity_note: The 0.75 A main-rail design capacity remains a transient/electrical stress capability, not the release steady U201 thermal source.
